source='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    top=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v]
    for c,color in top:
        endpoints=[]
        for r in range(1,h):
            if grid[r][0]==color: endpoints.append((r,0))
            if grid[r][w-1]==color: endpoints.append((r,w-1))
        if endpoints:
            r,edge=endpoints[0]
            for rr in range(min(0,r),max(0,r)+1): out[rr][c]=color
            for cc in range(min(c,edge),max(c,edge)+1): out[r][cc]=color
        else:
            for r in range(h): out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
fn=p/'task-487b025c.py'; fn.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(fn),'exec'),globals())
